name: Tuis
text: Tuis is a king of Greece in the tale of the children of Tuireann. The sons of Tuireann must win his magical pigskin as one of their fines. The dictionary routes the quest to the tragedy of that family. The pigskin counts among the impossible tasks laid on the brothers.
